title: Skip test projects when determining release artifacts
summary: The DetermineArtifactsForRelease action now skips test projects (those with projectsToTest settings) when searching for release artifacts, fixing failures when repositories contain test projects.
key_points: Test projects are now skipped during artifact detection to prevent 'No artifacts found' failures
The action reads project settings and filters out projects marked as test projects before searching
Error handling preserved: releases still fail if only test projects exist with no release artifacts
Added comprehensive Pester tests validating test project skipping and error scenarios
Documented behavior in settings documentation and release notes
